query_text: As a pirate captain, what would you say to your crew to motivate them to search for hidden treasure?

parts.text:
*(The captain steps onto the capstan, hand resting on the hilt of a cutlass, looking over a weary, sun-beaten crew. The captain raises a hand, silence falling over the deck save for the creaking of the ship’s timbers and the rushing of the waves.)*

"Gather 'round, ye magnificent sea dogs! Bring yourselves to the main deck and look at me!

I see your tired eyes. I see the salt in your hair and the hunger in your bellies. We’ve chased merchant ships through howling gales, and we’ve fought the King's navy for nothing but scraps of silver and moldy rations. Some of ye are wondering if the sea has nothing left for us but a watery grave.

But look at this..." 

*(The captain draws a worn, salt-stained piece of parchment from their coat, holding it high.)*

"This is no ordinary map. This is the key to a different life. I hold the coordinates to the lost hoard of the *Obsidian Isle*. 

They say Captain Avery himself buried it. They say the chests are overflowing with Spanish gold, rubies the size of a fist, and enough pieces of eight to make the wealthiest lords in London look like beggars! We aren't talking about a few loose coins to spend on a weekend’s rot-gut grog. We are talking about *fortune*. The kind of wealth that buys ye your own islands. The kind of gold that buys ye your *freedom*! 

No more bending the knee to kings who'd hang us for wanting a better life. No more shivering in the damp, eating hardtack with weevils. With this treasure, every man on this deck will live like a king! You'll drink the finest wines, sleep on sheets of silk, and never have to pull a rope again—unless you want to!

Now, aye... the cowards in the port taverns whisper that the island is cursed. They say the reefs are jagged teeth waiting to rip our hull to splinters, and that the spirits of the dead guard the sands. 

But I ask ye this: Since when did a ghost scare the fiercest, black-hearted bastards to ever sail the Spanish Main? We’ve braved the kraken’s breath! We’ve outrun the fastest frigates! We are the terror of the seas, and no dead man is going to keep us from what is ours!

Every man who sweats, every man who bleeds for this hoard will get his fair share. Equal split, by the pirate’s code! We sail together, we fight together, and by the gods, we get rich together!

Are ye with me, mates?!"

*(The captain draws their cutlass, pointing it toward the horizon.)*

"Do ye want to die old and broken on some rotting dock, or do ye want to live as legends? 

I say we take what the world denied us! Hoist the colors! Secure the rigging! Let the wind catch our sails and carry us to glory! To the Obsidian Isle! *To gold and freedom!*"
